_doc: Which model one wake runs on, beyond the seat's own chain (docs/ROUTING.md). Read by company/tools/lib/routing.js decide() for every run the dispatcher (company/tools/dispatch.js) and the Sprint lanes (company/tools/lanes.js) start, and by company/tools/routing.js (the owner's switches and the trials). A missing company/work/models/routing-policy.json reads this default; neither = no routing at all, every wake runs on its chain exactly as before. company/tools/routing.js is the company copy's only writer (created from this default on the first change; locked-watch.js class F, owned by the people function). Every rule, threshold and weight is here, not in code: routing is tuned in production. A key left out is read as off / empty, never as a hidden default (the two log paths excepted: they fall back to the files named here). Every decision is recorded on the wake's company/state/wakes.jsonl row (field route) and in the decisions log; it changes the run's model only when its step's mode is live AND the station's override allowlist (company/state/override-allow.json, lib/override-allow.js) opens that pair for the seat now; otherwise the seat runs on its chain and the record says what would have run (wouldApply) and why not (reasons). Owner: the people function (the model manager); the mode switches and trial starts are the owner's.
_mode: off | shadow | live, for department routes (company/departments.json routes.<class>) and trials. off: not computed. shadow: decided and recorded (route.applied false, route.wouldApply), never applied. live: passed as the one-run override, and only when the override allowlist opens the pair. Owner only: routing.js mode <m> --by owner, or Settings > Models > Routing.
_classRules: <class>: { denyProviders: [provider ids], denyModels: [model ids] }: owner rulings that hold in every mode. A pair a rule denies is never chosen for a wake with an item of that class: not from a route, a trial arm, the tier cap or the router's chain choice, and routing.js trial create refuses a trial with such an arm. Owner ruling: code is never written on the MiniMax plan (provider custom). No command changes it: a reviewed harness change (harness-change.js).
_classRulesApply: whether the class rules' chain fix is a step of the walk: always (live in every mode, shadow and off included: when a wake's chain pair is denied for its class, the seat's first allowed chain entry is applied whenever the allowlist opens it), mode (the fix follows mode like a route), off (not a step). Whatever the value, the class rules always hold after the walk: a denied pair is never offered as a choice; when nothing else applied and the seat's own pair is denied, the first allowed chain entry the allowlist opens is applied, and with none open the wake is held (hold: true), never started on the denied pair.
_order: the steps, first choice wins. classRules filters every step. trial: a running trial's arm. route: the department's route for the class. tierCap: the cap below. chain: the seat's own chain (changed only by the class rules). The applied choice is the first live step whose pair the override allowlist opens (a live pair that is not open is recorded and the walk goes on); the recorded wouldApply is the first step whose mode is shadow or live.
_tierCaps: executor tier caps (docs/MODEL_POLICY.md: routines run on Haiku or Sonnet). mode: off | shadow | live, its own switch (owner only: routing.js tiercaps <m> --by owner, or the console). For a seat that holds none of exemptFunctions and (exemptLeads) leads no department, a wake with no item marked `**Effort:** <heavyEscape>` may only run on an allow entry ({provider} alone matches every model of that provider; model aliases are listed one by one): when the seat's current pair is not one, the cap picks the seat's first chain entry that is; with none it records 'no capped entry' and leaves the chain. itemlessWakes: whether a wake with no handoff item (a scheduled loop, an owner message) is capped too.
_trialLimits: what routing.js trial create accepts: arms per trial (minArms to maxArms), the largest entryShare, and the defaults for --entry-share, --min-items and pauseWhenHeld (every arm provider the pacer meters as a subscription is added to defaultPauseWhenHeld on its own).
_trials: the framework defines none: a trial runs only where a company's own policy lists one, drafted by the people function or the owner (routing.js trial create) and started by the owner. Each: { id, class, arms: [{provider, model, effort}], scope: {departments: [ids], seats: [ids]} (a seat in neither list is out of scope; both empty = nobody), entryShare (0-1: the share of in-scope wakes of that class that enter), status: draft | running | paused | done (only running assigns), pauseWhenHeld: [provider ids] (while the pacer holds any of them the trial assigns nothing; the router records op trial-held / trial-unheld in the history file; it resumes by itself), minItemsPerArm (the sample each arm needs before the trial is read; reported, never acted on here), createdAt, createdBy, startedAt, startedBy }. Assignment is deterministic: sha256(trial id + wakeId) picks entry and an arm by even split. An arm that cannot run (not open, held) is recorded as such and the wake runs its chain; the trial never switches a wake to another arm. A trial with an arm the class rules deny is skipped whole.
_proposals: the weekly routing suggestions (docs/ROUTING.md "Weekly suggestions", routing.js proposals). mode: off | shadow (the suggestions are recorded, no owner card, nothing applied) | live (one owner veto card per suggestion: it applies after vetoDays unless the owner keeps it as it is; the applied route then follows the routing mode above, the owner's separate switch). Owner only: routing.js proposals mode <m> --by owner, or Settings > Models > Routing > Weekly suggestions. weekday (1 = Monday .. 7 = Sunday) and hourLocal (company time): when the week's look happens, at most once per ISO week. maxPerWeek: suggestions per week; maxTierStep: the most tiers one move may jump (light, standard, heavy, top in company/model-policy.json; a model with no tier reads as light); topTierNeedsCeo: a move onto a model whose id contains one of these needs the CEO's yes before the owner's card; minItems: the items the suggested setup's cell needs. One move per department and class a week.
_allowMaxAgeMin: an override allowlist older than this counts as none (the station refuses it from 30 minutes)
_history: the routing log: changes and events only, one schema {at, ts, op, by, ...}. routing.js appends one row per change (op mode | tiercaps | trial-create | trial-start | trial-pause | trial-resume | trial-stop, with trial?, from?, to?, why?, digest); lib/routing.js appends op trial-held / trial-unheld (by dispatcher, trial, providers, why) when the pacer pauses or resumes a running trial. locked-watch.js class A (both writers record each append with provenance.js). A .jsonl under company/work/; anything else reads this path. Rolled monthly, 180 days / 2 MB (company/defaults/work/ops/retention.json routing-log).
_decisions: the router's per-wake decisions: one row per routed wake {at, ts, wakeId, seat, door, jobId, runId, status, route} (route is the same object as on the wake's wakes.jsonl row). Written by lib/routing.js record(); never shown as a change. A .jsonl under company/work/; anything else reads this path. Rolled monthly, 90 days / 16 MB (retention id routing-decisions).
